# Tattoo ink colour picker -> marker genes -- generated by
# harness/tattoo/ink_colour.py; do not edit. One entry per target and channel;
# its value is a script value read straight from the stored number (verified
# in game 2026-09-11): the character's own variable (real characters, set at
# game start) or, with no character scope / no variable, the ruler designer's
# global -- the designer preview portrait has an EMPTY scope, so every
# has_variable is behind 'exists = this'. Lives in trait_portrait_modifiers so it
# re-evaluates on designer portrait rebuilds. Hue 0-99, saturation/brightness
# 1-100; values floored at 0.004 (zero-weight decals are dropped).

elf_ink_colour_picker_hue = {
	elf_ink_colour_picker_hue_any = {
		traits = {}
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					exists = this
					has_variable = ed_ink_hue
				}
				exists = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_hue
			}
		}
		dna_modifiers = {
			human = {
				morph = {
					mode = add
					gene = elf_ink_hue
					template = elf_ink_hue_marker
					value = {
						value = 0.004
						if = {
							limit = {
								exists = this
								has_variable = ed_ink_hue
							}
							add = { value = var:ed_ink_hue multiply = 0.00992 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { exists = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_hue }
							add = { value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_hue multiply = 0.00992 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
